tickets.title: Evaluate Paper Otter Life term policy reinstatement
tickets.text: Evaluate reinstatement of Soren Cloudpuddle's $750,000, 20-year Paper Otter Life term policy before losing the existing underwriting terms. The lapse notice followed a failed premium draft after the Teacup Comet Bank checking account was replaced.
tickets.evidence: 2024-12-13 agreed: evaluate lapse/reinstatement after notice showed draft failure when checking was replaced, before losing existing underwriting terms.

tickets.title: Review Cloudpuddle term and disability protection
tickets.text: Review term life coverage and disability protection for Soren and Lila Cloudpuddle against the $620,000 primary-residence mortgage, childcare needs, and education-funding exposure for Rowan, age 6. Account for Lila's reduction to part-time paid work and the resulting increased household dependence on Soren's salary.
tickets.evidence: 2024-12-20 agreed: review term-coverage/disability-protection after Lila reduced paid-work to part-time, increasing household dependence on his salary, with mortgage/childcare/education-funding exposure.
